text: Static shot from a ceiling-mounted CCTV camera inside a regional train passenger cabin, matching the reference image exactly: same seats, same window layout, same lighting. Two standing passengers in the aisle suddenly begin shoving each other, escalating into a physical altercation with grabbing and pushing motions. Nearby seated passengers react by leaning away and turning to look. The train continues moving steadily, with the window background scrolling past. The camera remains completely static, fixed mount, no camera movement, no zoom, no cuts.
negative_prompt: camera pan, camera shake, blurry, distorted architecture, extra doors, extra windows, text overlay, subtitles, cartoonish, unrealistic proportions
